issues.explanation: The diff adds models, policies, middleware, Livewire components, routes and views but ships no Pest/PHPUnit tests, violating the mandatory test-first convention including unauthorized-call and tamper tests for Livewire actions.
Entity creation performs the domain write directly in CreateEntity::submit via DB::transaction instead of going through an app/Actions/* class as the conventions require for domain writes.
The entity.pick route authorizes with a manual membershipFor null check and abort(403) instead of going through EntityPolicy via authorize/can as the authorization convention requires.
The 0/1/>1 membership dispatch (onboarding vs set-session-and-continue vs switcher) is duplicated between ResolveCurrentEntity and the /home route closure instead of being reused.
The single-membership fast path dereferences first()->entity without a null check, so a membership whose entity is soft-deleted would fatal instead of handling the edge case.
The navbar runs memberships()->count() on every render, adding a query per page where a cached membership count or shared view data would suffice.

conventions.evidence: Follows #[Validate]+validate(), persistent middleware (AppServiceProvider.php:542), $fillable, reversible migrations, docs sync; deviates: domain write in Livewire not app/Actions/* (CreateEntity.php:120) and manual auth in entity.pick (routes/web.php:954) instead of policy.

readability.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:150 uniqueSlug, app/Models/UserRole.php:407 manageable, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:494 view/update/delete/manageSettings; small focused methods, clear names, no dead code found.

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_034022:719 owner_seq storedAs + 720 unique entity_memberships_one_owner; CreateEntity.php:107-147 validate+authorize+transaction+retry+audit+session+redirect; routes/web.php:916-968 home/switcher/pick/dashboard; EntityPolicy.php:489-518 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:436-463 match task rules.

scope.evidence: Every hunk serves the task (models, factories, migrations, policies, middleware, onboarding/dashboard/switcher/navbar, lang en+pt_BR, docs/database-schema.md, CHANGELOG.md); no members/settings pages, locale middleware, or unrelated refactors.

security.evidence: CreateEntity.php:103 #[Validate]+108 validate()+110 authorize(create); Dashboard.php:206 authorize(view); switcher.blade.php:848-850 {{ }} escaped buttons with is-link/data-current=1 vs is-light; pick aborts 403 before session write (routes/web.php:954); mass-assignment via hardcoded Owner role + auth()->id().

simplicity.evidence: Lean change reusing Eloquent/policies/Blade components; duplication: identical 0/1/>1 dispatch in ResolveCurrentEntity.php:59-76 and routes/web.php:919-932.

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/, test files, or Pest cases for models, policies, middleware, onboarding retry, dashboard 403, switcher, or pick despite new behavior everywhere.

review.summary: The change implements the full entities data model, policies, tenant session, onboarding with slug retry, dashboard, switcher and navbar entry per the contract. It is functionally correct and secure but ships with no tests and bypasses the Actions-layer convention, so it needs substantial rework before merging.
